'''2011 German National Championship Julien De Vos LS Coruscant: Night Club''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Julien De Vos]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Coruscant: Night Club (Virtual Block 5)|VB5-L-coruscantnightclub-pre.gif|label=Coruscant: Night Club}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
